verdict.rationale: Swell documents a Liquid templating layer compatible with Shopify theme tags, filters and objects, plus storefront-app themes (Proxima) that support the Theme Editor and theme upgrade, duplication and distribution. The Swell CLI covers themes and can push configuration files to a development store, which gives a code-driven deploy path. However, nothing in the evidence shows a local preview server or explicit version-controlled theme deploys. Missing for 10: documented local theme preview/dev server, explicit git/version-controlled theme deploy workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
